messages:
ari: hey all  day 1 checklist Qs: who do I contact for a badge pickup, who's the reviewer for service-repo access, and where's the short owners reference for escalation paths? also: who should i page if a model publish job silently fails?

mona: welcome ari! :wave: facilities handles badges (facilities@redwood.com). if you need it same-day DM me and i'll kick the kiosk job. you'll need to be in group `redwood-building-access`.

devin: repo access: open an access request in #eng-infra. use the helper or this snippet:
```/access-request repo:redwood-inference/model-serving role:developer reason:"onboarding: needs commit"```
then ping @devin for approval. paste the access id into your onboarding Jira ticket.

ari: great - thanks. quick follow up: i want a concise matrix i can keep nearby. is there a canonical short mapping?

kevin: short map (no link spam): runtime -> eng-runtime; serving infra -> eng-infra; api & gateway -> eng-platform; observability/alerts -> eng-sre; ml infra / model ops -> eng-ml. for customer-impacting regressions, include support@redwood.com.

ari: on the model publish fail: if a publish job completes but model versions are mismatched and customers see stale responses, who gets paged first?

kevin: page eng-runtime first (they own model serving behavior). if the issue looks like infra (OOM, nodes), eng-infra joins. if alerts indicate customer errors, eng-sre + support. escalate to incident channel if it's a P0.

onboard-bot: [auto] access request created: AR-7612 (repo:redwood-inference/model-serving) - reviewer: devin - status: pending.

mona: i'll add you to the "new hire owners snapshot" doc and DM badge next steps. 

ari: thanks everyone  super helpful. i'll file the request and update my Jira.
